title: CGB attends National Grain and Feed Association's 130th annual convention in Nashville
text:
CGB Enterprises attended the National Grain and Feed Association’s 130th Annual Convention in Nashville, Tennessee, according to an April 15 announcement. The event brought together leaders from across the grain and feed sector for two days of discussions focused on trade, safety, market volatility, and supply chain management.
The convention is significant as it provides a platform for industry participants to address ongoing challenges and share solutions that impact agricultural supply chains. Reliable transportation and infrastructure investment were highlighted as essential factors in keeping grain moving efficiently.
Key topics discussed included operational pressures within trucking, the need for greater efficiency across transportation modes such as rail, trucking, and inland waterways, and continued investment in infrastructure like locks and dams to support competitiveness. Attendees agreed that strong policy frameworks, resilient infrastructure, competitive networks, and robust partnerships are necessary for adapting to changing global conditions.
CGB Enterprises operates more than 113 grain sites equipped with barge, rail, and truck access throughout the Midwest according to the official website . The company employs over 1,700 people at its facilities according to the official website .
Notable personnel at CGB include founder Bob Frane who pioneered innovative barge freight trading according to the official website . The company has also earned recognition for industry-leading safety results according to the official website .
Additionally, CGB promotes diversity and inclusion efforts aimed at fostering a workforce environment of belonging according to the official website . CGB is affiliated with Zen-Noh Grain Corporation through joint ownership by ZEN-NOH and ITOCHU since the late 1980s according to the official website .
The company said it remains committed to partnerships and practical solutions designed to maintain a dependable agricultural supply chain both now and into the future.
